programme.title: The Kremlin Letter

programme.title: The Terrorists

Unfortunately for Tahlvik, the terrorists prove to be quite formidable. Meanwhile, another unit of the same extremist organization is holding an English ambassador hostage, which further complicates matters.

programme.title: Eyewitness
